# RDNSoft

> RDNSoft is a software development and technology consulting company based in Ankara, Türkiye. It builds custom software, AI and computer vision applications, data and signal processing software, and system integrations.

## Services
- [Software Development](https://www.rdnsoft.com/software-development): Custom web applications, enterprise platforms, internal tools, APIs and process automation.
- [AI & Computer Vision](https://www.rdnsoft.com/ai-computer-vision): Video analytics, object detection, image processing and recognition systems.
- [Data & Signal Technologies](https://www.rdnsoft.com/data-signal-technologies): Software for signal measurement, analysis, synchronization and technical data processing.
- [System Integration](https://www.rdnsoft.com/system-integration): Connecting software, hardware, APIs, databases and third-party platforms.
- [Technology Consulting](https://www.rdnsoft.com/technology-consulting): Architecture, integration planning and technical project delivery.
